course.generating: Building a course in the free space of this scan...
course.ready: Gates: {n}. Fly through START to start the clock. Shift+T hides the course
course.readySpoken: Gates: {n}. Fly through START to start the clock. Shift and key T hide the course
course.none: No course fitted the free space this time. Shift+G tries another layout
course.noneResize: No course fits this scan at Scene size x{s}. Shift+G sets x{to} and builds the course
course.wallsFirst: First the walls of this scan, then the course.
course.early: Course: one moment, its tools are still loading.
course.failed: This course did not come out. Shift+G builds another one
course.off: Course hidden. Shift+T shows it again
course.menu.load: Course: fly the course saved for this scene
course.server.offer: This scene has a course saved by pilots: Shift+T flies it
course.server.loading: Loading the course saved for this scene...
course.server.loaded: Course for everyone, gates: {n}. Fly through START to start the clock
course.server.refused: The saved course does not fit the walls here, so it is not shown. Shift+G builds a new one
course.server.failed: The saved course did not load this time. Shift+T tries again, Shift+G builds a new one
course.save.done: Saved: every pilot who opens this scene can fly this course
course.save.failed: The course was not saved this time. Press save again
course.edit.title: Course editor
course.edit.opened: Editor open. W A S D move the view, E up, Q down, hold the right mouse button to look around, the wheel sets the speed. Click a gate: it carries one set of handles at a time, chosen by Move, Turn or Size on the bar under it (or M, R, T); pull them with the mouse. Space or your controller's arm switch flies the course (hold Space to climb); a short Space or the switch again goes back to editing. Esc leaves
course.edit.keyOff: {key} works in flight, not in the editor: press Esc to leave the editor, then {key}.
course.edit.ok: Every gate is clear of the walls
course.edit.key.order: earlier or later in the order
course.edit.key.window: to the window: name, buttons, courses (Tab walks them)
course.edit.p.outside: gate {g} is outside the scanned space
course.edit.p.startWall: the start is in a wall
course.edit.p.legWall: the way from gate {a} to gate {b} goes through a wall
course.edit.p.legStart: the way from the start to gate {b} goes through a wall
course.edit.fix.outside: Gate {g} is outside the scanned space. Pull its arrows to bring it back in, or delete it with the cross on its bar.
course.edit.fix.gateWall: Gate {g} stands in a wall. Pull its arrows to move it out into the open, or delete it with the cross on its bar.
course.edit.fix.legWall: The way from gate {a} to gate {b} goes through a wall. Pull the arrows of gate {m} until the straight way between them is clear, or delete it with the cross on its bar.
course.edit.fix.legStart: The way from the start to gate {b} goes through a wall. Pull the arrows of gate {b} toward the start until the straight way to it is clear.
course.edit.fix.direction: Gate {g} faces away from the way in. Press Turn on its bar and pull a ring until it faces the way you come from.
course.edit.fix.startWall: The start of this course stands in a wall. Press G for a new course.
course.edit.fix.noStart: This course has no start. Press G for a new course.
course.edit.p.direction: gate {g} is turned {deg} degrees away from the way in
course.edit.r.minGates: Not deleted: a course needs at least {n} gate
course.edit.r.maxGates: The course is full. Delete a gate you do not need first: click it and press the cross on its bar. Then add the new one.
course.edit.r.sizeMin: Not smaller: {m} m is the smallest opening
course.edit.r.sizeMax: Not bigger: {m} m is the largest opening
course.edit.r.orderEdge: This gate is already at the end of the order
course.edit.r.same: The gate is already like that
course.edit.name: Your name
course.edit.savedMine: Saved as your course: {title}, version {v}. It is in Courses on the top bar
course.edit.saveRefused: Not saved: fix the red gates first. {why}
course.edit.allEdited: This course is changed: save it as your course with your name
course.edit.allDone: This course is already saved for everyone
course.edit.unsaved: The changes are not saved. Esc again leaves without saving
course.edit.unsavedAgain: The changes are not saved. Do it again to drop them
course.edit.nothing: Nothing changed: this course is already saved
course.edit.noCourse: There is no course yet: Shift+G builds one, then Shift+B edits it
course.edit.listEmpty: No course is saved for this scene yet
course.link.missing: The linked course is not on this scene's list (it may be hidden or deleted).
course.edit.savedAdmin: Saved as the admin's version: {title}, version {v}
course.edit.adminFirst: Save the course for everyone first, then the admin can save a version of it
course.edit.voteAfterLap: Fly a lap of this course to vote
course.edit.bar.addHint: Click the place for the new gate (Esc: no new gate)
course.edit.flyHint: Click a gate to change it. Fly the course (or key Space, or your controller's arm switch) flies it at once
course.edit.flying: Flying your course with the changes. Back to editing (or a short key Space, or the arm switch off) edits again
course.edit.cam.move: fly the view forward, left, back, right
course.edit.cam.look: Right mouse button held, or a left drag on empty space: look around
course.edit.cam.click: Click a gate: arrows move it, rings turn it, the centre box scales it
course.edit.cam.arm: arm and fly the course now (disarm: back to editing)
course.edit.key.cleared: all gates deleted (Ctrl+Z brings them back)
course.edit.r.noGate: The course has no gate yet. Press Add gate, then click where it stands
progress.what.wallsLighter: Walls (a lighter way for this large scan)
progress.step.voxelize: building the walls on your graphics card
progress.line: {what}: {step}. Step {n} of {m}, {pct} %. {elapsed} so far, about {left} left.
progress.lineOver: {what}: {step}. Step {n} of {m}. {elapsed} so far; longer than usual, still working.
progress.walls.thenCourse: Now the course is being built; its progress follows here.
progress.course.soon: Course ready: {n} gates. They appear in {s} seconds, keep flying.
progress.mayStop: The picture may stand still for up to {s} seconds now. The build goes on: wait, do not close the page.
course.hud.toStart: Fly through START to start the clock
course.card.title: Course done
set.course.lapSplash.help: When a lap ends its time shows large at the top of the view for a moment, green when it beats your best lap.
